description: Figure 3.2 illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters, using the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis is labeled “log r”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 8, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 35, and has tick labels at intervals of 5.  There are four lines displayed: a blue line with circle markers representing “T5 + LoRA”, which begins at approximately (0, 5) and increases to approximately (8, 27); a magenta line with plus markers representing “MBart + LoRA”, which begins at approximately (0, 25) and decreases to approximately (8, 23); a green line with square markers representing “T5 + AdaLoRA”, which begins at approximately (0, 27) and remains relatively steady at approximately 27 across the x-axis; and an orange line with diamond markers representing “MBart + AdaLoRA”, which begins at approximately (0, 15) and increases to approximately (8, 25).
